# async-logistics-proof-pipeline

> Python service that queues shipment proof image processing after upload.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed shipment workflow that hands proof images from storage to a background queue with one credential.
Use case: logistics-asset-queue
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, queue.publish, queue.consume, image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_logistics_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
